facts: Ancient cities of **Taraz** and **Otrar** in Kazakhstan were important trade centers on the Great Silk Road.
Some of the oldest **chariots** in the world, over 4000 years old, were discovered in Kazakhstan.
The **Golden Man**, found in the Issyk burial mound, is a symbol of Kazakhstan's independence.
In the 13th century, the territory of Kazakhstan was part of the **Mongol Empire** under Genghis Khan.
Kazakhstan is the birthplace of the first **domesticated horses**, dating back around 5500 years.
The **Mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi** is one of the greatest architectural monuments of the Timurid era.
The famous **Baikonur Cosmodrome** in Kazakhstan launched the first human into space – **Yuri Gagarin**.
In the 19th century, Kazakhstan actively resisted the **Russian Empire** under the leadership of **Kenessary Kassymov**.
The **Golden Man** (Altyn Adam), discovered in 1969, is one of Kazakhstan's most significant **archaeological finds**.
The **Saka warriors**, who lived in the Kazakh steppes, were known for their mobility and guerrilla warfare tactics.
